author: Jason Stys
summary: Search all jobs by account/state, page captured audit history and download exact reviews. Fixed request-key intent, real-client binding, timestamp precision, null wire fields and mobile overflow.
rationale: Makes integration support usable beyond the recent-activity feed and catches defects through real API/browser workflows.
limitations: Fictional-provider single-instance lab; its demo identity header is not production authentication.
Keyset pages are live and later audit requests capture new state, not an immutable historical reconstruction.
Legacy account/audit APIs remain unbounded for compatibility.
Discovery order is case-sensitive connector-ID order, not display-name order or scheduling priority; registry metadata is captured at construction.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
